lines.en: I hop between the swamp stems.
I leap, and my wings take over.
My tail sways behind me.
I fly low over the water.

lines.zh: 我从一株芦苇跳到另一株
lines.en: I hop from reed to reed.

lines.zh: 我的翅膀上有彩色圆斑
lines.en: Bright spots mark my wings.
I run a few steps along the mud.
I slide into the grass.
I take off and land again.
I step twice in the shallows.
I circle a dead tree.
I creep onto a trunk.
I perch with my wings folded.
The swamp water never stops.
Something in the mud shifted.
My tail hangs below the branch.
I am preening my wings.
I have found nothing at all.
There are plenty of insects here.
I flutter my wings twice.
Sunlight comes through the leaves onto me.

lines.zh: 我一动不动，等虫子飞近
lines.en: I hold still and wait for a bug.
I show my tiny sharp teeth.
My claws have a good grip.
The water throws the light back up.
I am small enough to hide.
You are standing in my swamp.
I tilt my head; you are very tall.

lines.zh: 我翅膀上的斑点你看见了吗
lines.en: Do you see the spots on my wings?

lines.zh: 你手上有甜浆果的味道
lines.en: Your hands smell of sweet berries.
I am not afraid; I can fly.

lines.zh: 你想让我落在你肩上吗
lines.en: Do you want me on your shoulder?
My tail has spines.
Stand still for a moment.
I hop a bit nearer to you.
A stretch of water lies between us.

lines.zh: 你看我的枝，我看你的手
lines.en: You watch my branch, I watch your hands.
I blinked, and you missed it.
Your boots are sinking into the mud.
I take off and circle half a turn.
We are rather close.
To catch me, you must look up.
My wing feathers are a mess.
My claws sink into soft mud.

lines.zh: 我在泥里滚了两圈才停
lines.en: I roll twice in the mud before stopping.
I cry out sharply.
My tail has dropped.
I draw myself in.
I hide in the leaves.
My wings still work.
I shake my wings; I can still fly.
I keep that in mind.
I know that sweetness.
These are sweet berries, are they not?
I have landed on your hand.
Do not move, I am eating.
This little bit is too few.
I take one and go.
My claws grip very lightly.
These beat anything in the swamp.
The sweet smell of berries reaches me first.
Take a step and I will fly after you.
You bumped right into me.
I am this small, and you still hit me.
I flew up out of the way.
My tail barb almost springs out.
I slipped off your shoulder.
My wing sweeps your face.

lines.zh: 我们擦过去，我掉了几根毛
lines.en: We brushed past and I lost a few feathers.
I landed on your hat.
I bounced off, no harm.
Move, I am coming through.
I will dance for you.
My tail is up.
These reeds can hide us both.
My call is a soft one.
We preen each other.
I land beside you.
We share one branch.
I am not much of a dancer, but I will try.
Plenty of insects in this swamp.
We will roost together.
I snatch it up and fly.
I grip it in my claws.
It is bigger than I am.
I carry it to a branch.
It fell; I will get it.
I hold it and take a look first.
I push it off the tree.
Whoever dropped it, I have it.
Let me see if it is edible.
I hide it in a hollow.
You touched my branch.
I look at you without blinking.
My tail barb points at you and sways.

lines.zh: 我翅膀张开，意思很清楚
lines.en: My wings are open, and the meaning is clear.
This is my swamp.
I am small, but my tail is venomous.
One more step and I sting.

lines.zh: 这味道我在沼泽里闻过
lines.en: I've smelled this scent in the swamp before.
I do not mean to give up this branch.
This spot is mine.
I crouch, ready to fly.
You have backed into the water, good.
I take this branch first.
You only have to look up.
I circle above your head.
I land behind you.

lines.zh: 我在枝上换了个落脚点
lines.en: I shift to another perch.
My tail stays pointed at you.
I am looking for your hands.
Raise a hand and I take off.

lines.zh: 我一边飞一边数你的动作
lines.en: I fly and count your movements.
I stay at the edge of your sight.

lines.zh: 你退开一步，我就跟一步
lines.en: You step back, I follow a step.
This is my final warning.
I hop from branch to branch.
You cannot catch me.
I circle again and again.
I flit from your left side to your right.

lines.zh: 我叫得很尖，是在催你走
lines.en: My call is sharp; it is telling you to go.
I whip my tail.
A spine goes into your hand.
Light, but it will numb you.
I strike and fly off.
You shake your hand twice.
The venom is working.
I loop round and come back.
I land on a branch and watch you.
Do not dig at my nest again.
That one landed truer.
I rake with my claws.
Your sleeve is torn.

lines.zh: 我落在你够不到的地方
lines.en: I land out of your reach.
The venom will slow you.
I fly up out of the reeds.

lines.zh: 沼泽里多了一对彩色的翅膀
lines.en: The swamp gains a pair of bright wings.
I land on the nearest branch.
I know this water's smell.

lines.zh: 我先绕着水面飞了一圈
lines.en: First I circled the water.
My spots flash over the water.
There are enough insects here.
I came from the woods over there.
I fold my wings and settle.
This swamp has no master yet.

lines.zh: 我从水草间弹上了枝头
lines.en: I spring from the water weeds onto the branch.
I let out a sharp call.
I rode the wind here.
My wingtips skim the water.
The swamp fog is still thick.
I land on the outermost branch.
Fire singes my wings.
I fell off the branch.
The water pulls me under.
The blast flings me away.

lines.zh: 箭头撕掉了我几根飞羽
lines.en: The arrowhead tears away a few of my flight feathers.
Magic weighs my wings down.
No insects left in the swamp.

lines.zh: 雷打在枯树上，我飞起来
lines.en: Lightning strikes the dead tree and I bolt.
The branch under me is gone.
